editorialNarrative.formCopy: Tampa Bay's Junior Caminero has a direct connection with Cleveland, the organisation that traded him in 2021. Across the diamond is Jose Ramirez, a friend and player he admires. Cleveland's own story includes first-round selections Gavin Williams, Chase DeLauter and Travis Bazzana. Those histories establish the people involved, not a confirmed Game 4 lineup or pitching assignment.
editorialNarrative.closingCopy: A trade is usually judged in hindsight. Here it becomes something supporters can see in real time: a player Cleveland once held facing the club that helped introduce him to professional baseball. Friendship with Ramirez adds familiarity without making the contest less exacting. Neither connection needs an invented revenge motive to make a plate appearance worth watching.

MLB lists Tropicana Field as the venue. This game is only played if earlier results leave the series undecided; its start time remains unconfirmed.
